securityTitle.value: Common Stock, par value $0.001 per share

footnotes.footnote: Represents shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of Silvia, Inc. (formerly known as ProCap Financial, Inc.) (the "Common Stock") underlying 502,513 restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the Reporting Person on May 19, 2026, under the ProCap Financial, Inc. 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of Common Stock upon vesting, in accordance with the terms of the award. The RSUs vest as follows: 125,628 RSUs on July 6, 2026; 125,628 RSUs on October 6, 2026; 125,628 RSUs on January 6, 2027; and 125,629 RSUs on April 6, 2027, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued service and the other terms of the award. No shares of Common Stock were issued to the Reporting Person on the grant date, and the Reporting Person has no voting or dividend rights with respect to the underlying shares of Common Stock unless and until they are issued.

Consists of (i) 3,638,580 shares of Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in the merger of Silvia Merger Sub, Inc. with and into CFO Silvia, Inc. on April 6, 2026, (ii) 435,644 shares of Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in the merger of Silvia Merger Sub, Inc. with and into CFO Silvia, Inc. on April 6, 2026 and held in escrow for the benefit of the Reporting Person to secure indemnification obligations under the related merger agreement, which shares may be voted by, but may not be transferred by, the Reporting Person while so held, and (iii) 502,513 shares of Common Stock underlying the RSUs reported herein, none of which had vested or been settled as of May 19, 2026.
